name: Confidential Transfer
description: Encrypt Neo N3 transfer-intent fields locally and store only ciphertext for downstream Morpheus processing. This MiniApp does not move funds, verify a TEE attestation, or execute settlement.
description_zh: 在浏览器本地加密 Neo N3 转账意图字段，仅为后续 Morpheus 处理保存密文。本小程序不会转移资金、验证 TEE 证明或执行结算。

operation_panel.title: Confidential Intent Workspace
operation_panel.subtitle: Use the native privacy airlock to validate, encrypt, store, and recover ciphertext packets.

tee.description: Morpheus TEE processing is a downstream target, not an enabled or verified capability of this MiniApp. The client only seals ciphertext and requires a secret reference from storage.

zk.description: This MiniApp intentionally avoids claiming Neo-side zk verification. It only creates ciphertext for a downstream confidential-compute workflow that is not attested or verified here.
